text:
RADIUS::rtdom
Description
This command overwrites the default RD ID in RADIUS scenario with
given value
Syntax
RADIUS
::
rtdom
<
value
>
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
if
{
[
RADIUS
::
code
]
==
4
}
{
set
rd
0
# Extract the APN information from the AVP
set
called_station_id
[
RADIUS
::
avp
30
"string"
]
if
{
$called_station_id
==
"station1"
}
{
set
rd
1
}
elseif
{
$called_station_id
==
"station2"
}
{
set
rd
2
}
# Overwrite the default route domain value with the new value.
RADIUS
::
rtdom
$rd
}
}
